verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a DevOps platform like GitLab, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents acting on many items at once, such as bulk-editing issues or merge requests or bulk-dismissing vulnerabilities. The GitHub importer is a one-time migration tool, and the CLI and agent orchestration claims are adjacent building blocks, not a bulk-operations capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
